Hi all,

I looked into the invoice and ledger for account NovusAI (HS-98432). Findings:

- The $200 promotional grant was created on 2028-10-12 and correctly attached to the account.
- The invoice dated 2028-10-17 was generated by our billing run at 00:00 UTC; it appears the invoice generation preceded the finalization of the promo allocation job by ~3 hours. That timing mismatch caused the invoice to show the raw token usage (12,345 tokens -> $43.21) without the post-run credit offset.
- VAT line: Because the billing entity is Redwood EU Ltd, and no VAT ID was on file for NovusAI at the time of invoicing, the system added statutory VAT (10%) per our tax settings for Germany. If you provide your VAT ID we can evaluate whether the charge is eligible for reverse-charge/exemption.

Options to resolve:
1) Issue a credit memo for the $43.21 (plus VAT) and reissue a corrected invoice showing credit application. This is the quickest fix and will clear the apparent charge from your books.
2) If you prefer, we can keep the invoice as-is while issuing a one-week free credit extension (equivalent token budget) and a corresponding credit note applied to your next billing period.

If NovusAI can provide an EU VAT number, we can also reverse the VAT on the credit memo (subject to tax team approval).

I9ve attached the detailed line-item export and will submit BILL-2121 to tax for the VAT reversal assessment.

Let me know which option you9d like; I can action option (1) within 24 hours or (2) and issue the extension today.

- Marissa
